composition_label: Document review -> Behavioral personalization -> Deep research

construction.implementation_origin: New, independently authored isolated reference implementation

envelope.review: null until reviewed; checked_evidence, document_checks, gaps, notice
envelope.behavior: null until personalized; ranking, review_gaps, cold_start, weights, notice
envelope.deep: null until synthesized; reading_order, findings, disagreements, unresolved_questions, notice

input_records.requirement: id, question; nonblank text; unique id
input_records.document: id, title, text, evidence[]; unique id
input_records.evidence: id, requirement_id, stance (supports|contradicts), quote; globally unique evidence id
input_records.event: id, document_id, kind (browse|purchase), at; unique event id

validation: One shared validate function checks every stage on entry and exit.
Strict object fields, nonblank strings, referential integrity, unique IDs, timezone-aware timestamps, no future events.
Evidence quotes must exactly occur in source text; offsets are Unicode character offsets, end-exclusive, first occurrence.
Deterministic stage contracts are recomputed to reject tampered handoffs including missing evidence or changed scores.
CLI rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid JSON, invalid schemas and file errors.
shared_schema.error_contract: One JSON object with status:error and error:{type,message}; exit 2. Success emits one JSON envelope; exit 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated document_checks, checked_evidence and traceable requirement gaps; original validated events remain in the shared envelope.
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Ranking of all reviewed documents with evidence IDs, traceable event contributions, coverage prior and copied review gaps.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated ranking, ranked evidence IDs, scores and review gaps, resolving quotes through retained reviewed evidence.
cross_stage_handoffs.produces: Rank-ordered citations and reading order; complete per-requirement synthesis, unresolved gaps and polarity disagreements.

behavior.review: Exact quote and requirement checks; no-support and contradiction gaps. Evidence stance is supplied by the synthetic fixture, not inferred or independently verified.
behavior.ranking: score = distinct evidenced requirements / total requirements + sum(event_weight * 0.5 ** (age_days / 30)); browse=1, purchase=3. Contradictory and supporting evidence contribute equally to coverage.
behavior.cold_start: No global history uses coverage prior and document-ID tie-breaking; unseen documents retain the same prior. No minimum score filter.
behavior.determinism: Fixed input as_of, sorted identifiers and stable score/document-ID ordering; no system clock, randomness, network or provider.
behavior.synthesis: Extractive per-requirement findings retain every citation. Both polarities yield disagreement; absent support or any counterevidence yields unresolved questions. Popularity never resolves evidence conflicts.
behavior.edge_cases: No documents is permitted and produces unresolved gaps; requirements must be nonempty. Contradict-only evidence is unresolved, not a two-sided disagreement. Empty history is supported.

included: One integrated CLI and shared immutable-style envelope
Deterministic traceable review, personalization and multi-document synthesis
Synthetic fixture and offline unittest suite
excluded: Certification, compliance assurances, factual truth verification
Live research, scraping, networks, LLM calls and model providers
Semantic stance inference, embeddings, recommender training
Cross-user profiling; input events represent one anonymous synthetic session

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object; status ok; stage deep
cli.error_cases: Missing file and invalid arguments return one JSON error with exit 2; malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers and invalid schemas also tested.
